from PIL import Image, ImageFilter
im=Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
a=np.asarray(im).astype(np.float32)
box=im.filter(ImageFilter.BoxBlur(18))
mean=np.asarray(box).astype(np.float32)
sq=Image.fromarray((a*a).clip(0,255).astype(np.uint8)).filter(ImageFilter.BoxBlur(18))
msq=np.asarray(sq).astype(np.float32)
var=np.clip(msq-mean*mean,1,None)
std=np.sqrt(var)
z=(a-mean)/(std+1e-3)
# dark relative -> negative z. map to 0-255 centered
out=np.clip(128+ z*40,0,255)
Image.fromarray(out.astype(np.uint8)).resize((1400,709)).save('/tmp/local.png')
print('ok')
